annotations.title: Open auction of one name, if any

description: The open auction of one name, if any: venue, deadline, bid and the first-year cost. Use it when someone asks whether a name is at auction now, its current bid or its deadline. Pass `name` (such as get.plumbing).

fields.description: Comma-separated top-level keys to keep: venue, venueLabel, endsAt, bid, bidCount, currency, firstYear, bidsJumped.

name.description: A full domain name on an ending in the catalog, such as harbor.io: lowercase, an internationalized name as punycode. A bare word, a subdomain, an email address or an unknown ending is refused with the reason, and a suggestion when there is one.

name: ud_get_name_auction

next.description: The next page on the API, when there is one.
